time_mapping.ordering: look 1 late, look 2 central, look 3 early

cross_spectrum_domain_choice.chosen_domain: intensity images derived from the preserved complex sub-looks
cross_spectrum_domain_choice.primary_source: Li, Mouche, Stopa & Chapron (2019), JGR Oceans, doi:10.1029/2018JC014638, section 2.2.1
cross_spectrum_domain_choice.source_method_summary: The SLC azimuth spectrum is divided into three non-overlapping parts, inverse transformed into sub-look intensity images, and 2-D image cross-spectra are then formed.

roi.description: Open water immediately seaward of the central rocky coast; no land in the projected SICD polygon.

peak_search.conjugate_pair_treatment: centro-symmetric power average; one half-plane retained

three_look_peak_stability.reason: Best triplet did not pass all wavelength/orientation/prominence thresholds.
three_look_peak_stability.orientation_semantics: The 2-D FFT peak gives the modulation wavevector; visible crest/stripe orientation is perpendicular (+90 degrees, modulo 180).

cross_spectra.reason: No three-look peak passed the predeclared robustness thresholds.

land_control_deterministic_terms.domain: 8-column block-averaged land intensity; approximately isotropic ground pixels
land_control_deterministic_terms.complex_sublook_note: The three complex sub-looks occupy disjoint Doppler bands, so land registration and deterministic phase-ramp checks are performed on their intensity images.
